audio.credibleSource: FM Synthesis with triangle wave oscillators, velocity-sensitive ADSR envelopes, and dynamic touch curves

generatedSources.name: FM Synthesis Piano Model
generatedSources.description: Tone.js PolySynth with triangle wave oscillator, ADSR envelope (attack: 5ms, decay: 200ms, sustain: 30%, release: 500ms), velocity modulation, and touch curve adjustment (heavy/medium/light)

polyphony.description: Round-robin voice allocation with oldest voice stealing when polyphony limit exceeded

effects.masterVolume: Tone.Gain node with 0-1 range ramped over 100ms
effects.reverb: Tone.Reverb with 2.5s decay, wet/dry mix controlled 0-1
effects.compressor: Tone.Compressor with -30dB threshold, 3:1 ratio, 3ms attack, 250ms release

sustain.fullSustain: MIDI CC 64 >= 64, extends release envelope via timeout
sustain.implementation: noteLifecycle service tracks sustain state; PianoEngine delays note-off when sustain active

notes: Web Audio API with Tone.js library provides credible piano-like synthesis without recorded samples
No network dependencies; all synthesis occurs in browser using Web Audio API
Fallback mode displays 'fallback' label when Web Audio unavailable, visual feedback only (no audio)
MIDI input supported via Web MIDI API with graceful degradation if unavailable
All input sources (pointer, touch, keyboard, MIDI) funnel through unified NoteLifecycleService
Touch curves (heavy/medium/light) adjust velocity response; dynamic compression (0-3) smooths dynamics

pointer.velocityCalculation: Y position normalized to 0.3-1.0 range (top = loud, bottom = soft)

touch.velocityCalculation: Touch force if available, else Y position normalized

keyboard.description: QWERTY mapping to piano notes in C4-E5 octave range
keyboard.mapping: Q-U-I-O-P: C4-B4, A-L: C#4-G#5, Z/X: octave down/up, Space: sustain, Escape: all-notes-off

midi.description: Web MIDI API support for MIDI devices
midi.noteMapping: MIDI note-on/off with velocity (0-127 normalized to 0-1)
midi.controlChange: CC 64 (sustain pedal) wired to sustain state

knownLimitations: 32-voice polyphony limit (can tune upward with browser headroom)
Sustain is binary (on/off); half-pedal simulation pending
FM synthesis tone is stylized, not acoustic piano sample matching
MIDI latency depends on browser scheduling (typically 5-50ms)
iOS Safari may delay sample/resource loading on first visit
Mobile keyboard input may interfere with QWERTY mapping
Touch pressure detection not available on all devices (Y-position fallback used)
